violation_type.title: Records for Primary Caregiver - Current Driver's License or Photo ID (26 TAC §747.909(3))
violation_type.short_title: Records for Primary Caregiver - Current Driver's License or Photo ID
violation_type.typical_finding: The primary caregiver of the home did not have a photo copy of her driver's license. There were copies of her training on file and not a training record.

finding_variants.text: The primary caregiver of the home did not have a photo copy of her driver's license. There were copies of her training on file and not a training record.
The caregiver is missing a copy of photo identification in her file. This was correcetd when a copy of her drivers license was added to her file.
The primary caregiver did not have a copy of her ID on file.
The primary caregiver did not have a copy of their driver's license on file at the operation. The primary caregiver file was also missing a training record.
